word-atlas.changes: 提取 72 个精确匹配词条的英美音标、义项、生活例句（不含雅思学术句）、搭配、词族与用法提示，未逐条改动文本。
word-atlas.exampleAudioVoice: ElevenLabs "Alice" (UK)，来自词光仓库 public/atlas/audio/ex，CC BY 4.0。

taoread-original.note: 17 个词光无精确匹配的词条由桃阅读按词光编写规范自备，面向 5-7 岁改写。

senses.en: Used to show a place or a time.

example.en: The cat is at the door.
example.zh: 猫在门口。

entries.tip: at 用来指出小地点或时间点，比如 at the door、at six。

senses.en: Past form of sit.

example.en: The cat sat on the mat.
example.zh: 猫坐在垫子上。

entries.tip: sit 的过去式是 sat，不说 sitted。

senses.en: To touch gently several times with a flat hand.
A gentle touch made with a flat hand.

example.en: She patted the dog gently as it fell asleep.
example.zh: 狗渐渐睡着时，她轻轻地拍抚着它。

collocations: pat someone on the back｜轻拍某人的背
give someone a pat｜轻拍某人
entries.tip: 过去式patted、现在分词patting均双写t。

senses.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe
to touch or hit something lightly

example.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
example.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

collocations: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
entries.tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

senses.en: refers to a thing, animal, or situation already mentioned
used as a grammatical subject or object without naming anything

example.en: I found your scarf and put it by the door.
example.zh: 我找到了你的围巾，把它放在门边了。

entries.tip: 小写it是代词；大写IT才表示信息技术。

senses.en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom
to be in a particular place or position

example.en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
example.zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。

entries.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

senses.en: To drink a little at a time.
A very small drink.

example.en: I sip hot milk slowly.
example.zh: 我慢慢地小口喝热牛奶。

entries.tip: sip 是一小口一小口地喝，大口吞咽不叫 sip。

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something

example.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
example.zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。

collocations: the tip of the tongue｜舌尖
entries.tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

senses.en: Inside a place, container, or larger area.
During a period or after a stated amount of time.

example.en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
example.zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。

entries.tip: in two days常指两天后；月份、年份前也用in。

senses.en: a small pointed metal object used to hold things together
to fasten something with a pin or similar object

example.en: She used a pin to hold the fabric together.
example.zh: 她用一枚大头针把布料固定在一起。

entries.tip: pin作动词时，过去式pinned，进行式pinning。

senses.en: a short sleep, usually during the day
to sleep briefly, usually during the day

example.en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
example.zh: 星期天午饭后，我小睡了一会儿。

entries.tip: 动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

senses.en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food
to criticize a performance, book, or film very harshly

example.en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
example.zh: 先把锅里的油烧热，再放入洋葱。

entries.tip: 作动词时过去式为panned，现在分词为panning。

senses.en: A piece of material covering or protecting a surface.
To twist hair or fibres into a thick tangled mass.

example.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering.
example.zh: 进门前请在垫子上擦擦鞋。

entries.tip: mat通常是小块功能性垫子，不等同于carpet。

senses.en: A drawing showing where places or features are located
To draw or record the position of places or features

example.en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
example.zh: 出发前，我们把地图铺在桌上。

entries.tip: map作动词时，过去式mapped，分词mapping。

senses.en: An adult male human
Human beings considered collectively

example.en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
example.zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。

collocations: man a desk｜在服务台值守
entries.tip: 复数为men；泛指人类时现代写作更常用humankind。

senses.en: A boy's name.

example.en: Sam and his dad ran in the park.
example.zh: 山姆和爸爸在公园里跑步。

entries.tip: 英文人名的首字母要大写，如 Sam。

senses.en: An informal word for father.

example.en: My dad made a hat for me.
example.zh: 爸爸给我做了一顶帽子。

entries.tip: dad 是口语叫法；写作或正式场合常用 father。

senses.en: Not happy.

example.en: The sad boy lost his hat.
example.zh: 难过的男孩丢了帽子。

entries.tip: sad 的反义词是 happy。

senses.en: To put something briefly into liquid and take it out.
To fall slightly, often for a short time.

example.en: Dip the strawberries in chocolate before putting them on plates.
example.zh: 先把草莓蘸上巧克力，再放到盘子里。

collocations: a dip in sales｜销量的短暂下降
entries.tip: 过去式和过去分词为dipped；现在分词为dipping。

senses.en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something
Search carefully for hidden information

example.en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
example.zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。

entries.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。

senses.en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.

example.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
example.zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

entries.tip: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

senses.en: An empty space between things or within something.
A difference between people, groups, or situations.

example.en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
example.zh: 小猫从篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

collocations: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口
entries.tip: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

senses.en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work.
To cause persistent problems for someone or something.

example.en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
example.zh: 我们的狗每天下午都守在门边。

entries.tip: 动词常见被动式be dogged by，表示长期受困扰。

senses.en: a small round mark
to appear in scattered places across an area

example.en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
example.zh: 她的黄色雨伞上有蓝色圆点图案。

entries.tip: on the dot表示准时，常接在具体时刻之后。

senses.en: A deep container used for cooking food.
A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks.

example.en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
example.zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。

entries.tip: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

senses.en: the highest part or surface of something
highest in position, rank, or quality

example.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
example.zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。

entries.tip: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

senses.en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
An animal belonging to the same family as lions.

example.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
example.zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。

entries.tip: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something

example.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
example.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

entries.tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

senses.en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.
A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances.

example.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
example.zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。

entries.tip: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

senses.en: A child or young person, in informal language.
Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed.

example.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
example.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

entries.tip: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

example.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
example.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

entries.tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw.
A small enclosed area where animals are kept.

example.en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
example.zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？

entries.tip: pen泛指墨水笔；钢笔可明确说fountain pen。

senses.en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.
To gently touch an animal with your hand.

example.en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
example.zh: 我们的宠物兔喜欢躲在厨房桌子下面。

entries.tip: 动词过去式为petted；英式英语中抚摸也常用stroke。

senses.en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them
remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted

example.en: A small silver fish wriggled inside the fishing net.
example.zh: 一条银色的小鱼在渔网里扭动。

entries.tip: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。

senses.en: The star that gives Earth light and heat.
The light and warmth coming from the sun.

example.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
example.zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

entries.tip: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

senses.en: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds.
A decorative container awarded for winning a competition.

example.en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
example.zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。

collocations: a reusable cup｜可重复使用的杯子
entries.tip: a cup of后接饮品；cup作动词可表示用手捧住。

senses.en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.

example.en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
example.zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。

entries.tip: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。

senses.en: Past form of run.

example.en: The dog ran to the gate.
example.zh: 狗跑到了大门口。

entries.tip: run 的过去式是 ran，不是 runned。

senses.en: move quickly on foot, lifting both feet between steps
manage a business, organisation, or activity

example.en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
example.zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。

entries.tip: 过去式ran，过去分词run；现在分词running。

senses.en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse

example.en: A rat disappeared behind the bins near the gate.
example.zh: 一只大鼠钻到大门附近的垃圾桶后面，不见了。

entries.tip: rat通常指大鼠，mouse通常指体型较小的小鼠。

senses.en: having the colour of ripe tomatoes
the colour of ripe tomatoes

example.en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
example.zh: 她穿着一件红色外套去了冬季集市。

entries.tip: in the red表示负债或亏损，不是字面上的红色。

senses.en: a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration

example.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
example.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

entries.tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

senses.en: A female chicken.

example.en: The hen laid an egg.
example.zh: 母鸡下了一个蛋。

entries.tip: hen 是母鸡；公鸡的英文不是 hen。

senses.en: To jump on one foot or make small jumps.
A small jump, especially one made on one foot.

example.en: The little bird hopped across the wet garden path.
example.zh: 那只小鸟蹦跳着穿过湿漉漉的花园小径。

collocations: hop on a bus｜迅速上公交车
entries.tip: 过去式hopped，进行式hopping，需双写p。

senses.en: Past form of hide.

example.en: The cat hid under the bed.
example.zh: 猫藏在床底下。

entries.tip: hide 的过去式是 hid。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

example.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
example.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

collocations: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
entries.tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping
The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake

example.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

entries.tip: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

senses.en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
to transport people somewhere by bus

example.en: We caught the last bus home after the concert.
example.zh: 音乐会结束后，我们赶上了回家的末班公交车。

entries.tip: by bus不加冠词；take a bus需加冠词。

senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow

example.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
example.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

entries.tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

senses.en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability
a flat rubber covering worn on a foot for swimming

example.en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
example.zh: 我们看见一个鲨鱼鳍刚刚露出水面。

entries.tip: 指潜水脚蹼时常用复数fins。

senses.en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience.
Enjoyable and entertaining.

example.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
example.zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。

entries.tip: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

senses.en: a body part used for standing and walking
a support beneath a table, chair, or similar object

example.en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
example.zh: 走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。

collocations: stretch your legs｜活动一下腿脚
entries.tip: leg也指桌椅的支脚或旅程中的一段。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

example.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
example.zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。

entries.tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

senses.en: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree
a detailed record of events or activities

example.en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
example.zh: 我们坐在湖边一段倒下的树干上。

entries.tip: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。

senses.en: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar.
A situation where movement stops because things are packed together.

example.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。

entries.tip: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

senses.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.
A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.

example.en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。

entries.tip: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。

senses.en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise.
A period of slow, steady running.

example.en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。

entries.tip: jog someone's memory意为“唤起某人的记忆”。

senses.en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.

example.en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
example.zh: 我们把箱子装进了一辆白色的小型厢式货车。

collocations: hire a van｜租一辆厢式货车
entries.tip: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。

senses.en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals
to check someone or something carefully before giving approval

example.en: The vet gently checked our puppy's ears and paws.
example.zh: 兽医轻柔地检查了我们小狗的耳朵和爪子。

collocations: take a pet to the vet｜带宠物看兽医
entries.tip: 动词过去式vetted，动名词vetting，均双写t。

senses.en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid
Having rain or frequent rainfall

example.en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
example.zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。

entries.tip: damp指微湿；soaking wet表示湿透。

senses.en: The system of connected pages accessed through the internet.
A structure of fine threads a spider makes to catch insects.

example.en: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
example.zh: 我在网上找到了一份简单的汤谱。

entries.tip: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

senses.en: Fake hair worn on the head.

example.en: The actor wore a red wig.
example.zh: 演员戴着一顶红假发。

entries.tip: wig 是戴上去的假头发。

senses.en: A long-haired ox from cold mountains.

example.en: The yak has lots of hair.
example.zh: 牦牛有很多毛。

entries.tip: 牦牛长着长毛，住在寒冷的高原上。

senses.en: A word that shows you agree.

example.en: Yes, I can hop like a frog.
example.zh: 是的，我能像青蛙一样跳。

entries.tip: yes 表示同意，它的反义词是 no。

senses.en: A fastener that closes bags and jackets.
To close something with a zip.

example.en: Zip up your red jacket.
example.zh: 把你红色的夹克拉链拉上。

entries.tip: zip 也能表示飞快移动，比如 The jet zipped by。

senses.en: A sound for something very fast.

example.en: Zap! The bug is gone.
example.zh: 咻！虫子不见了。

entries.tip: zap 是漫画里表示快速击中或飞过的拟声词。

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box

example.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
example.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

collocations: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
entries.tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

senses.en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.

example.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
example.zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。

collocations: an urban fox｜城市里的狐狸
entries.tip: 作动词表示“难倒”，主要用于英式非正式语境。

senses.en: The number after five.

example.en: I can see six ducks.
example.zh: 我能看见六只鸭子。

entries.tip: six 结尾的 x 发 /ks/ 音。

senses.en: A short test or game involving questions.
To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.

example.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
example.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。

entries.tip: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

senses.en: To stop doing something.

example.en: We quit the game to eat lunch.
example.zh: 我们停下游去吃午饭。

entries.tip: quit 的过去式还是 quit。

senses.en: away from a place or position
away from or no longer touching something

example.en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
example.zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。

entries.tip: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

example.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
example.zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

entries.tip: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

senses.en: A toy shaped like a person.

example.en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
example.zh: 我的小表妹把她的洋娃娃安顿在一张小床上。

entries.tip: 通常指人形玩具；用来称呼女性可能显得轻慢。

senses.en: a clothing item covering the foot and lower leg

example.en: One blue sock was hiding under the bed.
example.zh: 一只蓝袜子藏在床底下。

collocations: a pair of socks｜一双袜子
entries.tip: 一双袜子说a pair of socks，sock为可数名词。

senses.en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat
Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something

example.en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
example.zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。

entries.tip: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

example.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
example.zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。

entries.tip: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

example.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
example.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

entries.tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: A place where people buy goods or services.
To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.

example.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
example.zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

entries.tip: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

senses.en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh
to try to catch fish

example.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
example.zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。

entries.tip: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

senses.en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits
a small broken piece or the mark it leaves

example.en: The repairer replaced a damaged chip inside my laptop.
example.zh: 维修人员更换了我笔记本电脑内部一块损坏的芯片。

entries.tip: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

senses.en: The part of your face below your mouth.

example.en: He rested his chin on his hand and sighed.
example.zh: 他用手托着下巴，叹了口气。

collocations: rest your chin on your hand｜用手托着下巴
entries.tip: chin指下巴；jaw指颌部，范围更广。

senses.en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages.
A friendly, informal conversation.

example.en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
example.zh: 等公交车时，我们聊起了各自的周末。

entries.tip: chat with人、about话题；过去式chatted双写t。

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.

example.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
example.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

entries.tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

senses.en: An insect like a butterfly that flies at night.

example.en: A moth flew to the lamp.
example.zh: 一只飞蛾朝台灯飞去。

entries.tip: moth 长得像蝴蝶，但大多在夜里活动。

senses.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.
A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.

example.en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
example.zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。

entries.tip: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound

example.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
example.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

entries.tip: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.

example.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
example.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

collocations: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我
entries.tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

senses.en: To make musical sounds with your voice.
For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.

example.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
example.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

entries.tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。
